attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. ICRA Limited confirmed no material deviation in the utilization of IPO proceeds. Net proceeds were revised to INR 183.937 crore due to a reduction in issue-related expenses by INR 2.852 crore. Funds were utilized for opening new stores, anchor stores, renovating existing stores, purchasing machinery, and general corporate purposes. Unutilized funds of INR 78.00 crore were invested in fixed deposits with IndusInd Bank. The statement of deviation was reviewed by the Audit Committee.

attchmntText: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from its Initial Public Offering for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The net proceeds increased to INR 183.937 crore as of 30th September 2026, primarily due to a reduction in actual issue-related expenses by INR 2.852 crore. The company reports no deviation or variation in the use of funds raised. The monitoring agency is ICRA Limited. The audit committee and auditors have recorded nil comments. Funds were raised on 28th June 2024. Total utilized amount stands at INR 122.008 crore, with unutilized funds of INR 77.992 crore. The revision in general corporate purpose allocation is attributed to the lower actual issue-related expenses.

attchmntText: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November 2026. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 11,108 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 791 lakhs, with a profit for the period of 571 lakhs. Earnings per share were 1.00 rupees. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 were 55,138 lakhs. The company charged 192 lakhs as an exceptional item due to misappropriation of funds by its former Company Secretary. Legal action is underway to recover the amount. The statutory auditors expressed an unmodified conclusion on the results.

attchmntText: Intimation of Schedule of Earnings Call
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has scheduled an earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The conference call will take place on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 02:30 PM IST. Participants can join via dial-in numbers provided in the announcement. The call will feature Sunil Suresh, Shubha Sunil, and Venkataramana Seshagirirao Gorti. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The details are also available on the company website.
